The sec2.2.1 paragraph projection and a Methods-only biochemical-definition sentence projection did not yield an explicit lycopene-to-beta-carotene intermediate statement. L2020_TABLE1.table_caption: List of strains constructed in this study.
L2020_TABLE1.notation: ASCII beta represents the source Greek beta. Gene/promoter/terminator text is flattened from the source cell markup; TCYC is the construction table's literal terminator notation. No D-to-Delta normalization is accepted as a verbatim transcription.

AUTHOR_DILUTION_INPUTS.inspected_cells: Statistics!A1:C7, with column selection restricted to A:C
AUTHOR_DILUTION_INPUTS.value_interpretation: Column B is the author-released mean dilution-rate input. Column C is its standard error, not a replacement for the mean or a target-model input. No other sheet or cell values were inspected.

input_checks.finding: All six author condition codes are present exactly once with the elizondo2025_ prefix, and outer/inner experiment IDs agree. No author condition row is omitted or added. The source design has three named strains at two dilution regimes. This roster check does not independently establish the separate b-car* dataset-alias field.

Every recorded numeric value exactly matches its author's column-B mean in inverse hours, rather than a rounded nominal setpoint. Methods specifies nominal dilution regimes of 0.1 and 0.25 h^-1 and states that specific growth corresponds to dilution in a chemostat. This verifies the dilution-as-growth input convention under the stated steady-state regime, not an independent biomass-growth measurement.

The enumerated medium explicitly uses glucose at 12 g/L as the carbon source in carbon-limited aerobic continuous cultures. It is supplemented YNB, not an assertion that glucose is the only chemically carbon-containing ingredient.

Continuous chemostat cultivation, sampling after five residence times, and technical-triplicate intracellular sampling support the packet's balanced-growth intracellular readout basis as a protocol classification. The Methods describes intracellular accumulation and a steady-state interpretation. Actual physiological stationarity was not independently tested from outcome/time-series data.

source_coordinates: E2025_METHODS: sec2.1.1/p[2], entire enumerated cultivation recipe
input_checks.finding: The recipe lists 1x YNB without amino acids, carbohydrate or ammonium sulfate; histidine, leucine, tryptophan, methionine and uracil supplements; glucose; ammonium sulfate; and NaOH for pH control. It lists no extra NaCl intervention. Therefore 0.0 M is supported as the dose of an additional NaCl intervention, not as measured total NaCl, basal sodium, salinity or osmolality. Basal medium constituents and sodium introduced by NaOH must not be treated as zero.

source_coordinates: L2020_TABLE1: CEN.PK2-1c and inherited parental rows
input_checks.finding: The cultures use S. cerevisiae strains derived from CEN.PK2-1c. Hyphen/en-dash typography in the strain identifier does not change the reported background identity. The verbatim genotype field is checked separately.

source_coordinates: L2020_TABLE1: beta-Car2.1, beta-Car3 and beta-Car4.b rows
input_checks.finding: Methods explicitly renames beta-car2.1, beta-car3 and beta-car4.b as beta-car2, beta-car3 and beta-car4, respectively. In particular beta-car4 refers to beta-Car4.b, not beta-Car4.a. The construction table's capitalized Car and ASCII beta are notation normalizations, not copy-number evidence.

Methods explicitly identifies CrtE, CrtYB and CrtI as heterologous genes from Phaffia rhodozyma. These genes are present in the inherited construction-table genotypes. No donor synonym or extra construct is substituted.

source_coordinates: L2020_TABLE1: Parental strain, Genotype and Integration site cells for beta-Car2.1, beta-Car3 and beta-Car4.b
input_checks.finding: Explicit parental-cell traversal and counting the named genes in each inherited integration reproduce all packet units and copies. In CrtE/CrtYB/CrtI order the totals are 1/1/1, 2/2/2 and 3/3/2. No count is inferred from the strain's numeric label. These are construction-copy counts, not measured expression, enzyme abundance or fitted flux capacity.

The sources support beta-carotene-pathway strains and intracellular sampling/accumulation of lycopene alongside beta-carotene. This check is confined to pathway/readout metadata and does not establish the separate intermediate-role claim or inspect any measurement values.

packet_jsonpaths: $.experiments[*].strain_and_construct.construct_evidence (claim that Delta replaces a source Greek character)
input_checks.finding: The inspected primary XML cell contains literal D, not a Greek delta. Even allowing case/spacing typography, the packet's as_reported string and its Greek-Delta explanation are not literal transcriptions of this source. This is a transcription failure only; it does not establish a biological genotype difference. The biological equivalence of D and Delta was not guessed, and the packet was not edited.

The permitted author column is strainConditions, with combined codes 2D01 through 4D025; it is not a separate strain column and does not expose literal b-car* aliases. The paper gives beta-car* labels. The code set is consistent with the paper's design, but a separate author alias or independently tabulated code-to-strain key cannot be certified from the allowed projection. No disallowed dataset column was opened to infer it.

native_DS28911_W303_to_CEN_PK2_1c_YNB_eq.finding: Explicit assumption only. No native model data or legacy calibrations were opened, and target-study outcome or exchange-rate values were not used to adjust the priors. No equivalence is certified.

total_basal_sodium_nacl_or_osmolality.finding: Only the absence of a separately enumerated NaCl intervention is supported. The basal formulation and pH-control sodium contribution are not a zero-salinity claim.
